 Fall is settling into a comfortable rhythm with no big changes on the way. 
 By David Wolter Published : Oct. 23, 2026 at 2:40 PM CDT | Updated : 3 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google BOWLING GREEN, Ky. (WBKO) - Fall is settling into a comfortable rhythm with no big changes on the way.
 Tonight the forecast looks great for the BGPD Trunk or Treat and high school football games. It is turn fairly cool immediately after sunset so don’t forget that extra layer before you head out.
 More sunshine is expected as we continue through the day on Saturday with highs in the middle and upper70s. (David Wolter) Expect consistency over the next week, with afternoon highs holding in the middle, possibly 70s. 
 Mornings will feel crisp and cool, with lows dipping into the lower to middle 40s. A few patchy areas of fog will be possible during the late night and early morning hours, mainly in river valleys.
 The dry stretch continues through much of next week. Our next chance for rain may not arrive until later next weekend around November 1st, or during the first full week of November.
